questions.text: Sorry, I know this is a strange thing to ask a stranger. Do you know whether the owner of this phone is a man or a woman — can you tell?
questions.hint: Open the photo gallery and look for a selfie photo of the owner

questions.text: A barista, and she's never once mentioned him to me. Can you tell where he went last night, after her party finished?
questions.hint: Look in the Calendar at yesterday's date to find a note at 11pm

questions.text: That's where Nell and her friends ended up. Girls only, she told me. What was he doing in there?
decoys: She won't notice me following her.
She doesn't know I'm here tonight.
questions.hint: Open the Notes app and look for the note titled 'The Sable Room'

questions.text: I feel sick hearing that. I want to know where he lives. What's his address?
questions.hint: Open Email and look through Emmett's sent messages to Rowan Beck - one of them gives his apartment's address, near a king cake shop.

questions.text: A museum. She's looking at paintings right now with no idea. He once said her face looks just like someone he used to know. What was that person's name?
questions.hint: Look in the Messages for an old conversation with Mom that talks about an ex

questions.text: He's been hunting for a finished relationship in my sister's face. There's a locked album on this thing — can you get me the code?
He kept a photo of Delia somewhere - I remember him editing it once, swapping her face for another girl's. The original photo must be of Delia. Can you find where he stored it?
questions.hint: Use the code you just found to open anything it unlocks.

onboarding.text: Hi... I'm Barrett. Sorry, this is going to sound like nothing. Somebody left a phone on the counter at Solo Espresso and I picked it up.
onboarding.label: Barrett

onboarding.text: I only wanted a name so I could hand it back. Then the screen lit up and my sister was on it. Nell. She's the reason I never left New Orleans.
onboarding.label: Nell & Emmett

onboarding.text: The face on the lock screen is a stranger. Not one of her friends. Not anybody she's ever brought home, and I've met all of them. I keep telling myself that's nothing.
onboarding.label: Emmett

onboarding.text: It was her birthday last night. She went out with her friends, and she hasn't answered me since this morning. I'm keeping hold of this phone... Please tell me whose it is.
onboarding.label: Barrett

Emmett, bring the Tesla back right now!
Ok ok, I'm on my way right now
Your mother is cooking your favorite dish tonight

Emmett! Last night was a good time
Yeah it was a good time!
Know any other bars like that one?
Wanna check one out some night?
Perfect! I'll message you as soon as a night opens up
Appreciate it, but I like where I am
If you change your mind just say the word
Owen!! As if I could forget you
Doing well — I'm based in New Orleans now
3 months now, landed a job in IT
No way! We have to meet up
For sure, first round is on me
To celebrate being back in the city

Good spot, everything is close by
Come over and I will cook first, then we head out

Yeah, and she goes easy on the first half
Bring water though, that room gets warm
Emmett, that coffee this morning — thank you
Lovely, see you in the morning
Honey, we need to have a talk
About you. About how you've been acting since Delia left
No Emmett, just listen to me
You've become obsessed with that girl
Yes it is! You spend all your days hunting for a replacement

notes.title: Camera notes
notes.body:
Work the hour on either side of sunset - warm light, gentle shadows
Divide the frame in nine and set the subject along a line
Open right up to f/1.4-2.8 when the background has to disappear
Out on the street, point the camera where the movement is going
Get the eyes right or the portrait is nothing
Once it is dark, no tripod means no photograph
